newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corporate bond supply meets with good demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corporate bond supply meets with good demand.

text.p: Corporate bond new issuance continues to chug along at a steady pace as anxious investors rush to meet new supply, dealers said.
"Debt issues should continue to flow in as long as the demand for the paper is there...and recent supply has met with very good investor interest," said one syndicate source.
U.S. corporations continue to capitalize on the favorable interest rate environment to finance debt as paper-hungry investors greet the new supply with open arms, dealers said.

Abbey National Plc's new 7.35 percent perpetual note deal was also met with strong investor interest, prompting the issue to be upped in size from an initial $300 million to $500 milllion, dealers added.
"The deal was upped in size to meet demand and was still issue-bid on the Street," said one high-grade syndicate source.
Abbey National 7.35 percent notes tightened two basis points in secondary trading and were seen bid at 76 basis points after pricing at a spread of 78 basis points on Wednesday.
As new straight corporate debt supply is absorbed, a number of asset-backed issues, private placements offerings and preferred deals are on the horizon, dealers said.
